os-28-21.alt: Three rows of drawings showing labor. Top row, stage 1: side views of a pregnant uterus with the fetus head-down in amniotic fluid; on the left the cervix below the head is closed and thick, and on the right it has opened fully around the head. Middle row, stage 2: four side views of the birth, with the head emerging face-down, the head turned and the front shoulder delivered, the back shoulder delivered, and finally the lower body and umbilical cord. Bottom row, stage 3: a drawing of the emptied uterus with the placenta peeling off its wall and moving toward the vagina, beside a photograph of a delivered placenta in a tray.
